limits: The mirror and GPU output can have different compositor phases. Cyclic colors cannot distinguish whole-period differences, and capture cadence is not physical display cadence or latency.

gpu: ANGLE (Intel, Intel(R) UHD Graphics (0x0000A788) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)
method: Fully offscreen 1920x1080 VP9 60fps playback, 27-color cyclic input, neutral filters, 162px reading blur. Independent fixed Canvas 2D mirror requests current video pixels on each display callback. Four seconds of CDP JPEG95 compositor captures are classified after capture. Signed lag is mirror frame minus ambient frame modulo 27; positive values indicate ambient behind the mirror. Native video is outside the capture viewport.
